title: Winter Wonderland
description: a mod that adds some frozen dimensions to minecraft, made for christmas
body:
currently, there are some issues with the mod, when running the game it struggles to load

Winter Wonderland is a mod that adds 3 frozen dimensions to the game, each with unique blocks, mobs, and biomes to explore. There are frozen variants of existing mobs, candy cane blocks, as well as the mobs Santa and The Grinch. This mod was created in only 7 hours and I tried to release it before christmas but started making the mod on christmas eve so my bad. There is still more to be added, altho this will be my last mod of 2025, because it was made for the holidays, I don't think I'll continue updating this mod after I fix it

This mod was made using MCreator
